_note: The Keyguard Designer how-to course: every video in viewing order, from the support assets proposal (October 2026). The renderer reads titles and 'watch next' from here, so a title is changed in one place. 'id' is the script's id (scripts/video/scripts/<id>.mjs); an entry with no id has no script yet. 'path': true marks the groups watched in order. A video's number never changes once it's published, because its watch page's address comes from it; a new video goes at the end of its group.
